test_inputs.explanation: The execution log only exposes URLs (including the new product setup at /admin/catalog_product/new/set/4/type/simple/ indicating an Attribute Set with ID 4 and a Simple Product type) but does not show concrete field values, typed text, or selected option labels. Magento's default admin workflows and typical demo data strongly suggest using the 'Default' attribute set and 'Simple Product' type. Because no credentials or product details are visible in the trace, all text values here are plausible, valid Magento inputs chosen to be consistent with the observed product type and attribute set and to form a coherent, replayable test case (unique SKU, numeric price/qty/weight, valid enum values for status, visibility, tax_class, and stock_availability). They should work against a standard Magento setup but are inferred, not directly observed from the trace.
